appDescription: A driving coach app that gives beginner drivers spoken feedback on speeding and sharp curves and tracks their progress toward graduating from the coach.

function.name: GET_DRIVING_STATUS
function.description: Tell the driver how their current trip is going, including any speeding or sharp curve mistakes so far.

function.name: GET_TRIP_DISTANCE
function.description: Tell the driver how far they have driven on the current or most recent trip.

function.name: GET_GRADUATION_PROGRESS
function.description: Tell the driver how close they are to graduating from the driving coach.
